reducedMotion.behavior: Keep short fades; disable displacement, scale, springs, and decorative particles.

presets.label: Quiet
presets.description: Short fades and small movements that keep attention on the task.

presets.label: Spring
presets.description: A responsive, gently springing feel for direct interaction.

presets.label: Celebration
presets.description: A little more lift for milestones and rewarding feedback.

components.name: MotionReveal
components.usage: Cards, result panels, and newly added content.
components.stateBoundary: Mount once around newly introduced content.

components.name: MotionSwitch
components.usage: Steps, questions, tabs, and local view changes.
components.stateBoundary: Only outgoing and incoming children remount; keep editors and persistent controls outside.

components.name: MotionFeedback
components.usage: Success messages, validation errors, and status updates.
components.semantics: status for success/info; alert for error

components.name: MotionButton
components.usage: A small compression that confirms a button press.

components.name: MotionProgress
components.usage: Progress updates with a bounded 0–100 value.

components.name: MotionCelebration
components.usage: A bounded, decorative burst for completed milestones.
components.semantics: Decorative particles are hidden from assistive technology

constraints: Use celebration only after an explicit milestone
